title: Mal’akha (angel)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Menachot 41a, an angel found Rav Katina. Rashi explains that this was an angel.[^1]

notes.text: מלאכא is Mal’akha, not Malka (מלכא). Angel follows the cited sentence and Hyman’s explicit attribution to Rashi; this is not a human-name authority binding. מא. gives Menachot 41a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Rav Katina has full רב.
